مَجْدُوفٌ A [skin of the kind called] زِقّ having the legs cut off: and so with ذ. (K, * TA.) And مَجْدُوفُ اليَدَيْنِ A man having the arms, or hands, cut off. (TA.) ―
-b2- And [hence,] the latter, (assumed tropical:) A niggardly man. (TA.) ―
-b3- And مَجْدُوفُ الكُمَّيْنِ, (K, TA,) and اليَدِ, and القَمِيصِ, and الإِزَارِ, (TA,) (assumed tropical:) Short in respect of the sleeves, (K, TA,) and of the arm, and of the shirt, and of the waistwrapper. (TA.) ―
-b4- See also مُجَدَّفٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
